spec.description:
Autex Verve - Acoustic Timber is a contoured acoustic wall panel that combines
sculptural, light-responsive geometry with high-definition digital timber
prints. Manufactured from 100% polyester fibre with an 80% recycled PET core, it
moulds static surfaces into expressive three-dimensional architectural features.
Available across six distinctive contoured profiles and 14 timber grain prints,
it provides acoustic absorption (NRC 0.30+) and Group 1 fire compliance without
the weight or fire risks of solid timber.
features:
Sculptural 3D
contoured profiles: Pillar, Flute, Ovolo, Pinstripe, Ridge, Windswept

High-definition digital printing of 14 realistic timber woodgrains using
water-based UV ink

Engineered from 100% polyester fibre containing a minimum
of 80% recycled PET

Available in 12mm (6mm edge) and 21mm (15mm edge)
thicknesses

Generous panel dimensions of 2680mm or 2700mm height by 1170mm
width
Sound absorption performance starting from NRC 0.30 and higher
Group 1 fire rating compliant with AS ISO 9705 - 2003 and AS 5637.1
Glue-free SpinFix mechanical mounting or direct adhesive fixing options
Resistant to moisture, mould, and mildew (ASTM G21-15 Growth Rating: 0)
Certified Carbon Neutral product with third-party verified EPD

install:
Check wall substrate is flat, plumb, dry,
and structurally sound

Acclimatise panels in the installation environment for
at least 24 hours prior to mounting

Plan panel layout ensuring contoured
profiles and timber grain direction align seamlessly

Apply high-grab MS
polymer adhesive evenly to panel back or install using Autex SpinFix clips

Position panel, butt joins neatly at pattern low points, and apply uniform
pressure across face

Trim bottom or top perimeter edges cleanly using a track
saw with a fine-toothed blade

Confirm wall

limitations:
Indoor use only; avoid wet areas or direct
water exposure

Panels join at pattern low points; verify vertical alignment
along panel seams
Pinstripe profile is available in 12mm thickness only

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Verve - Acoustic Timber is a 3D contoured acoustic wall
panel that combines sculptural light-and-shadow relief with high-definition
digital timber grain printing. Formed from 100% polyester fibre with an 80%
recycled PET core, it is available in six expressive profiles (including Flute,
Ovolo, and Pillar) and two thicknesses (12mm and 21mm) in 2680mm x 1170mm
sheets. Achieving Group 1 fire compliance under AS ISO 9705 and an acoustic
absorption rating of NRC 0.30+, it delivers the warm tactile aesthetic of fluted
architectural timber without the weight, cost, or fire hazards of solid wood.
